scripts.setup: pnpm run setup:certs && pnpm install && pnpm be sync
scripts.generate:api: pnpm be openapi && pnpm fe api:generate
scripts.lint: pnpm fe lint && pnpm be lint
scripts.format: pnpm fe format && pnpm be format
scripts.redis:logs: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml logs -f redis
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && uv run taskiq worker app.core.taskiq:broker --fs-discover --tasks-pattern "app/modules/**/tasks.py"
scripts.dev:scheduler: cd backend && uv run taskiq scheduler app.core.taskiq:scheduler --fs-discover --tasks-pattern "app/modules/**/tasks.py"
